guarantees.claim: Parameter Mux2SelWidth is bound to the integer value 3.

assumptions.claim: Any signal of type mux2_sel_e must only be driven to MUX2_SEL_0 (3'b011) or MUX2_SEL_1 (3'b100); no other 3-bit value may appear.
assumptions.cond: when the mux2_sel_e signal is used as a select in downstream multiplexer logic
assumptions.risk: An unexpected 3-bit value causes an ambiguous mux selection, potentially routing unintended data (e.g., key, plaintext) into output or control paths, leading to data corruption or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The mux2_sel_e enum has a 3-bit width but defines only two valid encodings (3'b011 and 3'b100), leaving 6 of 8 possible values unenumerated. No default or invalid value is specified. If any of the unenumerated values ever appear on a variable of this type (e.g., due to a soft error, uninitialized register, or bug), downstream mux logic may behave unpredictably.
uncertain_points.cond: when a signal of type mux2_sel_e takes an unenumerated 3-bit value
uncertain_points.risk: AES internal mux select ambiguity could cause secret/key material to be forwarded to an incorrect destination, violating data isolation and potentially exposing sensitive information.
